_comment: Rows the TameRegen pak adds. TameRegen itself is Lua; these rows put its switches into the game's own Custom World Settings screen (escape menu -> Custom World Settings, host only): D_CustomGameStats rows are rendered by that screen automatically, each bound to a hidden world stat in D_Stats. The Lua reads the values from the ProspectSubsystem's settings array. Row names are prefixed QoL_ so a later collection of quality-of-life features can share the pak. This file must not touch any table mod/data/patches.json touches (both paks replace whole tables; build.py checks).

tables._comment: World stats the settings bind to. Hidden; the Lua never reads the stat, only the setting.

add.Name: QoL_TameRegen_?
add.Title: NSLOCTEXT("D_Stats", "QoL_TameRegen_?-Title", "Tame Regeneration (TameRegen)")
add.PositiveDescription: NSLOCTEXT("D_Stats", "QoL_TameRegen_?-PositiveDescription", "Tames on Follow heal faster out of combat")

add.Name: QoL_TameRegenRate_+
add.Title: NSLOCTEXT("D_Stats", "QoL_TameRegenRate_+-Title", "Tame Regeneration Rate (TameRegen)")
add.PositiveDescription: NSLOCTEXT("D_Stats", "QoL_TameRegenRate_+-PositiveDescription", "{0}% of maximum health per minute")

tables._comment: The switches as they appear under Creatures in Custom World Settings. Bool = toggle, Int = stepper between MinIntValue and MaxIntValue.

add.Name: QoL_TameRegen
add.Description: NSLOCTEXT("D_CustomGameStats", "QoL_TameRegen-Description", "Tames set to Follow heal a share of their maximum health every second while out of combat, scaled by their Nurtured Recovery talent rank. Off leaves the game's normal regeneration.")

add.Name: QoL_TameRegenRate
add.Description: NSLOCTEXT("D_CustomGameStats", "QoL_TameRegenRate-Description", "Percent of maximum health healed per minute at Nurtured Recovery rank 4; lower ranks get a share. 15 is the mod default: a 2,200 HP mount is back to full in about 7 minutes.")
